versions.changelog:
clawhealth-data-skill v0.5.1

- Updated SKILL.md to add a new section on the "First 7 Days Experience" with usage and guidance for initial user setup and interaction.
- Removed older doc file: skill-card.md, streamlining documentation.
- Clarified and organized documentation for user onboarding, data usage, and report cadence in SKILL.md.
- No changes to functionality; documentation improvements only.

ClawHealth Data Skill v0.5.0

- Updated descriptions and instructions for improved clarity, both in English and Chinese.
- Added new setup sequence guidance for first-time users, including app setup and Agent token storage.
- Expanded detail on proactive health event delivery and WeChat bridge integration.
- Updated tool list: removed deprecated endpoints, renamed health analysis API, and streamlined protocol explanations.
- Changed focus domains: now includes anomaly context, readiness, nutrition, and passive state detection.
- Removed skill-card.md file and cleaned README and SKILL documentation for better maintainability.
Update bilingual ClawHealth introduction and add clawhealth.site access link.
Fix temporary panel link handling: require panel_token, clarify network fallback, and tolerate escaped ampersands in panel URLs.
Adds nutrition monitor, basic profile targets, readiness and mood tracking, bilingual guidance, and updated ClawHealth panel workflow.
Adds invite-code onboarding model, daily weekly long-term reports, attention terminology, health-check guidance, and literature-backed supplement reasoning.
Use clawhealth.site as the public Skill host after custom domain setup.
Replace access-code chat flow with long-lived Agent API tokens, add daily health reports, and keep web panels on short-lived tokens.
Add network fallback for Agent runtimes that cannot reach the ClawHealth Vercel API
Initial ClawHealth data skill with temporary panel links, health analysis, healthcare-check guidance, and supplement protocol flow
